messages:
ivy-eng: deploy-bot just flagged text-embed:v2.0.5 in the late change window. p95 +30% and err ~2%. deploy-bot suggests AUTOREVERT. tagging @mike-oncall @sam-sre

deploy-bot: ALERT -> AUTOREVERT_RECOMMENDED. Criteria: p95>200ms for 4m, err>1.5% for 3m. Canary=10%. Options: AUTOREVERT or HUMAN_ROLLBACK.

ops-bot: telemetry snapshot: us-west-2=70% canary traffic, p95_usw2=240ms, p95_eu=170ms, err_rate=2.0%. No infra alerts; traces show tail latency on runtime-gpu-14.

sam-sre: we have dedicated pools on this route. manual rollback + pin to v2.0.4 to avoid oscillation. mike, can you take handoff and run rollback playbook?

mike-oncall: taking. Plan: 1) pause canary slice, 2) pin route to text-embed:v2.0.4, 3) disable autopilot for release, 4) run rollback job, monitor 10m.

mike-oncall: running commands:
```
deployctl traffic pause --release text-embed:v2.0.5 --slice canary
deployctl release pin --service text-embed --version v2.0.4 --reason "rollback: late-window perf regression"
deployctl annotate --release text-embed:v2.0.5 autopilot_disabled=true
/runbook run rollback-text-embed
```

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual-rollback initiated by mike-oncall; autopilot suppressed.

mike-oncall: rollback job rb-51099 in progress. replicas shifting back to v2.0.4. p95_usw2 down to 160ms after 3m, err 0.5%. monitoring 10m.

laura-pm: I'll draft a short customer note and update release notes draft after ops confirms.

mike-oncall: 10m monitor complete. stability restored across regions. closing rb-51099.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-51099 created for RCA assigned to eng-runtime and eng-ml. tags: latency, gpu-14, canary

ivy-eng: release notes updated: "Rolled back text-embed v2.0.5 to v2.0.4 due to latency/error increase in late change window; investigating." Pin locked 24h. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
